But the handover of power will take weeks, and the students' movement is concerned that evidence of possible wrongdoing could be destroyed in that time.
Just a few days ago, the park they were standing in on Thursday was a tent camp, filled with Vučić loyalists outside his office.

title: Could Trump’s Foreign Policy Cost the GOP the Midterms?
summary:
At first sight this appears to support the conventional wisdom that US voters generally don’t care about foreign policy.
But traditional understandings of the electoral importance of foreign policy often reflect misunderstandings about the way in which voters assess candidates for office.
One reason a president’s foreign policy might lose him or his party votes is when their administration’s choices directly affect the daily lives of voters.
But what these polls miss is the degree to which voters today are blaming the administration’s foreign policy choices for the poor state of the economy.
